level_0.input: three RGB-D camera views at time t
level_0.action: one 7D Panda action at time t
level_0.output: three RGB-D camera views at time t+1

level_1.input: three RGB-D camera views at the chunk start
level_1.output: three RGB-D camera views after the eighth action

views.loader_rule: group views by physical transition or chunk; never treat camera views as separate actions

depth.units: render-normalized; preserve metadata and normalize in loader

robot_state.purpose: optional auxiliary signal; images and actions are the H-JEPA inputs
robot_state.legacy_state_rule: raw simulator state arrays are diagnostic only and must not be model inputs
robot_state.loader_rule: use the canonical 30D state when present; otherwise ignore robot_state arrays

index_requirements.split_rule: split by trajectory or task, never by individual frames
